scripts.readyHeaders390: async(page)=>{await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});await page.goto('https://dashboard.bex.co/webhooks');await page.getByRole('columnheader',{name:'Endpoint',exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:15000});await page.waitForTimeout(1200);const measure=()=>page.evaluate(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('main table'),rect=e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height}};return{width:innerWidth,docWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,table:rect(t),container:rect(t.parentElement),scrollWidth:t.parentElement.scrollWidth,headers:Array.from(t.querySelectorAll('th')).map(e=>{const s=getComputedStyle(e);const chars=[];for(let j=0;j<(e.firstChild?.textContent||'').length;j++){const r=document.createRange();try{r.setStart(e.firstChild,j);r.setEnd(e.firstChild,j+1);const x=r.getBoundingClientRect();chars.push({char:e.firstChild.textContent[j],y:x.y,height:x.height})}catch{}}return{text:e.textContent,...rect(e),whiteSpace:s.whiteSpace,overflowWrap:s.overflowWrap,wordBreak:s.wordBreak,lineHeight:s.lineHeight,chars}})}});const initial=await measure();await page.locator('main [data-slot="table-container"]').evaluate(e=>e.scrollLeft=e.scrollWidth);await page.screenshot({path:'qa-a832-webhooks-mobile-right.png'});const afterScroll=await measure();return{at:new Date().toISOString(),initial,afterScroll};}

mutation CreateService($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $type: String, $repo: String, $image: String, $registryCredentialId: String, $branch: String, $rootDir: String, $runtime: String, $buildCommand: String, $startCommand: String, $dockerfilePath: String, $buildFilter: BuildFilterInput, $plan: String, $autoDeploy: Boolean, $schedule: String, $command: String, $publishPath: String, $port: Int, $envVars: [EnvVarInput], $secretFiles: [SecretFileInput]) {
  createService(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}

mutation CreateWebhookEndpoint($ownerId: String, $name: String, $url: String!, $eventTypes: [String]!, $enabled: Boolean) {
  createWebhookEndpoint(
    ownerId: $ownerId
    name: $name
    url: $url
    eventTypes: $eventTypes
    enabled: $enabled
  ) {
    id
    name
    url
    eventTypes
    enabled
    secret
    createdAt
    __typename
  }
}

query WebhookEndpoints($ownerId: String) {
  webhookEndpoints(ownerId: $ownerId) {
    id
    name
    url
    eventTypes
    enabled
    disabledReason
    createdAt
    latestStatus
    latestSentAt
    latestParentStatus
    __typename
  }
}
